conviction_note: The FY26 numbers were pre-released on 1 Oct 2026 as in line with company-compiled consensus (adj. revenue £1,191.2m, adj. EBIT £77.7m), with net cash ahead. So the move sits in the FY27 outlook, the record order book figure and the dividend. Small offsetting findings (Porter Brothers accretion and a positive Costain read-across, against the ORR-documented cut to England & Wales rail renewals) give a slight lean: p_up 54 on abs 4.0 = +0.32, close to the findings' sum of +0.25.

bar: Company-compiled consensus quoted in the 1 Oct 2026 RNS: adjusted revenue £1,191.2m, adjusted operating profit £77.7m, pre-IFRS 16 net cash £6.3m (https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/renew-holdings--rnwh/year-end-trading-update-notice-of-results-/9800169). session_check: bmo. The issuer's 1 Oct 2026 RNS says preliminary results 'will be announced on Tuesday 24 November 2026', and every prior Renew results RNS (25 Nov 2025, 12 May 2026) went out at 07:00 London per https://www.investegate.co.uk/company/RNWH. This release itself has no timestamp yet.
positioning_check: FCA aggregated register as read in the baseline: 0.25% (position date 2026-09-14), down from 0.45%, so the shorts are covering and the position is small. On the long side, Moneta Asset Management built its stake from 3.04% to 5.02% (shares plus instruments) through 29 Oct 2026 (TR-1s of 2, 6 Oct and 2 Nov 2026). Nobody is crowded short.

findings.finding: Porter Brothers (PBU, EBIT £3.9m, roughly 5% of FY26 adj. EBIT) was acquired on 28 Oct 2026 and is 'immediately earnings enhancing'. The results are management's first chance to fold it, with PWR-X and EDES, into FY27 outlook language.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The acquisition RNS itself moved the stock +8.3% (28 Oct 2026). Finals with a 'confident outlook' moved +4.05% (25 Nov 2025) and +2.28% (28 Nov 2023); FY24 finals moved -3.89% (26 Nov 2024).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the stock gained 8.3% on the day and has since given back about 6.7% from its 1,096p close on 9 Nov. What is not priced is whether management turns the accretion into firmer FY27 language. That is the only residue here, so it is small.
findings.independence: Costain's 19 Nov 2026 CME sets out double-digit growth targets in the same water and energy markets: https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/costain-group--cost/capital-markets-event/9882972

findings.finding: The ORR's annual assessment of Network Rail (July 2026) found England & Wales renewals cut to 83% of the original CP7 plan. Rail is Renew's largest historical end-market, and its 1 Oct trading update was silent on rail while stressing Water and Energy.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Rail weakness caused the January 2025 trading update warning, which moved the stock -21.89% (24 Jan 2025). Since then H1 FY26 said Renew was capitalising on growing maintenance spend as Network Rail's largest infrastructure-services supplier.
findings.why_not_priced: The cut is public, and the company says the shift from renewals to maintenance favours it. The reason it may not be fully priced is that the FY27 outlook is the first company statement after the ORR finding that could quantify rail volume. If the market had priced a rail drag, FY27 expectations would have been trimmed after July and the stock would not have rallied to 1,096p in November. This is macro-to-company transmission with no company confirmation, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: Network Rail's own CP7 Year 3 delivery plan update says renewals planned for later CP7 years were scaled back: https://www.networkrail.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/GB-CP7-Delivery-Plan-Year-3-update.pdf (snippet only, not opened)

findings.finding: Peer read-across: Costain (rail, water, energy) used its 19 Nov 2026 capital markets event to reconfirm FY26 in line, set targets of c.10% revenue CAGR and >10% EBIT CAGR, and launch a £25m buyback. This is a confident customer-spend signal in Renew's end-markets, four sessions before the print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed Renew reaction to a peer read-across; RNWH fell 3.6% on 20 Nov, the day after Costain's CME, with no RNWH-specific RNS.
findings.why_not_priced: Peer evidence is public, and RNWH fell the next day rather than rising, so the market did not trade it as read-across. The finding is an inference about end-market demand and is sized small.

findings.finding: The FY26 net cash beat (ahead of the £6.3m consensus) is pre-released and was flattered by a one-off c.£6.9m insurance receipt. Filed at zero because the market already has it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The trading update containing it moved the stock +1.91% on 1 Oct 2026.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: it was disclosed on 1 Oct. Only underlying cash conversion excluding the insurance receipt is unknown.

findings.finding: Positioning skews long. A French fund house (Moneta) built from 3.04% to 5.02% between 29 Sep and 29 Oct 2026, and the disclosed short sum fell from 0.45% to 0.25%. Into the print the stock has drifted 6.7% below its 9 Nov high on light volume.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No crowded short in the record; the January 2025 warning fell 21.9% with no notable short position.
findings.why_not_priced: Holder accumulation is public and mostly priced. The pre-print drawdown has no cause in the filings and is worth nothing by itself, so this is sized small.
findings.independence: FCA aggregated net short register in the baseline: https://www.fca.org.uk/publication/documents/aggregated-current-net-short-positions.csv

outside_window.finding: Great British Railways operating-licence consultation closes 21 Jan 2027, with GBR operating responsibility from autumn 2027; the structural rail-procurement change lands after the window

baseline_tension: The findings lean slightly positive and agree with the small positive priced lean (+0.27) and the 20-day run-up of +5.6%, but cut against the 5-day run-up of -3.9%. Nothing contradicts the lean strongly.
language_note: The domestic RNS record on Investegate carried the TR-1s showing Moneta building to 5.02%, and the Costain CME RNS with its full target set, neither of which appeared in the English wire search results; otherwise nothing the English sources did not already carry
lessons_applied: 'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': the pre-released net cash beat went from +0.2 to 0.0
'Macro-to-company transmission is a hypothesis' and 'a narrow proxy loses': the rail-renewals finding went from -0.5 to -0.4 and the Costain read-across from +0.3 to +0.2

'The move is in the guide' and 'too small about the move': abs_move_pct went from 3.5 to 4.0, because the FY27 outlook is the first statement on the new year and realised vol is elevated (37%); p_up went from 55 to 54 because the period is pre-released and a reiteration is most likely
Positioning finding went from +0.2 to +0.15, because an unexplained drawdown is worth 0
